Are the four taints free from taints?
The path, the fruit, and Nibbāna; the stream-entry path, the stream-entry fruit … [and so on] … the enlightenment factor?
One should not say so … [and so on] … It should not be said—
“Are the four taints (āsava) themselves without taints (anāsava)?
“Are there indeed other taints, by which those taints become possessed of taints? — Yes.
It should not be stated thus.
For if that were so, the four taints would be without taints.
The Discussion of Taints is finished.
